target: public landing and private dashboard entry

contract.purpose: Explain App Health as a private endpoint-health product and route evaluators and existing operators to the correct next step.
contract.purposeSource: PROJECT_STATUS.md and the canonical App Health dossier
contract.canonicalPurpose: Privacy-first endpoint health for developers and service operators using a fail-open SDK or an existing OpenTelemetry feed.
contract.audience: Developers and service operators responsible for Node, Worker, Go, or OpenTelemetry services.
contract.job: Establish the product, privacy boundary, shipped proof, and separate evaluator and existing-operator journeys before authentication.
contract.thesis: A calm operational briefing: direct language, production-state evidence, and a private access card instead of generic observability marketing.
contract.system: Preserve the established off-white, ink, and green palette; rounded operational cards; compact evidence labels; responsive two-column desktop and stacked tablet/mobile layout.
contract.signature: A production-capability ledger that turns the product's route-summary and privacy contracts into visible proof.
contract.risk: Keep the private owner-key form on the public page because it is the real returning-operator entry point, while preventing it from obscuring the evaluator path with explicit lifecycle copy and primary install/release actions.

answers.product: A private endpoint-health dashboard for route traffic, latency, errors, and telemetry freshness.
answers.audience: Developers and service operators deploying instrumented Node, Worker, Go, or OpenTelemetry services.
answers.value: Focused operational visibility without collecting request bodies, parameters, or identities.
answers.mechanism: A fail-open SDK or existing OpenTelemetry feed produces aggregate route summaries across four operational time windows.
answers.proof: The page identifies a live production V0 surface and provides current-release, changelog, and source verification paths.
answers.nextAction: Evaluators read the install guide or verify the release; existing private deployments open the dashboard with an owner key; there is no public signup.

ownerFeedback.note: The owner delegated the portfolio landing-page quality pass while requiring priority-aware depth and no drastic redesign without consultation.
